admission.justification: Projection pruning, brief assembly, and launch-preparation metadata span three CLI modules that can silently drift and break replay or exceed wire budgets; guarded by the first-message and wire-token matrix suites.

applicability: Every native role launch handover projection built by role_handover_projection.py and assembled by role_brief_message.py.
conditions: Inline wire projection omits null fields, duplicate document/parent/returnAddress refs matching selection, leafSeats.roleMessageArguments, redundant taskDocumentFiles defaults, and duplicate inline handoverFile unless explicitly opted in.
Inline projection preserves task_name, slug, and copy-pasteable arMcpContext.readerArguments.shared.
Companion .handover.json remains 100% lossless and artifact_line / resolve_handover_envelope replay stays compatible.
exclusions: Complete canonical handover files on disk, which retain every full prose and structural field.
Messages sent after the role's first message.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_first_message.py, test_role_first_message_guards.py, test_role_handover_binding.py, test_role_instruction_wording_handover.py, test_capsule_replay_integrity.py, test_role_wire_token_budgets.py (clean-copy tree b3131ef29cf948ee4830a48540585bc841530c3a)

statement: Inline wire handover projections deduplicate repeated task/document/parent/seat/handoverFile fields and tighten wrapper prose while keeping the companion .handover.json 100% lossless, preserving task_name/slug and copy-pasteable arMcpContext.readerArguments.shared inline, and keeping artifact_line and resolve_handover_envelope replay compatible.
title: Deduplicated inline handover projection preserves lossless companion JSON
